bl_common.limitations: Provides shared scoring utilities, normalization, and Jaccard helpers.

b02_static.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor static baseline extractors (AST sequence, token Levenshtein, bytecode Levenshtein, TF-IDF)
b02_static.limitations: Measures lexical and syntactic surface similarity; blind to runtime semantics.

b03_execstats.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor execution statistics (call count, coverage size, exception fraction, event count, function count)
b03_execstats.limitations: Scalar summary features; serves as volume-control and execution-statistic baselines.

b04_valuespectra.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor value spectra adaptations (entry, exit, entry+exit variable values)
b04_valuespectra.limitations: Adapted from Xie & Notkin (2005) concepts into Python multiset distance; operates on internal execution values.

b05_pathspectra.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor path spectra adaptations (coverage sets, hit multi-sets, inverse path distances)
b05_pathspectra.limitations: Adapted from Reps et al. (1997) and Harrold et al. (1998/2000) line/branch spectra.

b05_traceseq.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor trace sequence alignment and k-grams (call/cre sequences, LCS, first-divergence, TF-IDF n-grams)
b05_traceseq.limitations: Sequence alignment over executed event logs; sensitive to loop unrolling.

b06_indep_inputs.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor independent input generator and differential executor (40 independent inputs)
b06_indep_inputs.limitations: Generates independent input battery disjoint from protocol 11 inputs to prevent label tautology.

features.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor master baseline feature extractor

models.provenance: Wave-1 predecessor supervised combiners and incremental regression models (LR, DecisionTree, RandomForest, Incremental)
models.limitations: Fitted strictly on v9c_train, selected on v9c_dev. Weights and trees frozen in EXP-A4C-002/models.pkl.

oracle_and_privileged_output_reading.disclosure: PRIVILEGED_LABEL_ORACLE. These methods evaluate black-box outputs on the exact 11 protocol inputs used to define the ground-truth benchmark labels. They reproduce the label by construction and serve ONLY as a label-oracle ceiling, not as fair blind competitors.

independent_input_output_differencing.disclosure: FAIR_OUTPUT_READING. Evaluates output differencing on an independently synthesised 40-input battery that does not have access to protocol inputs or labels.

internal_execution_spectra.disclosure: WHITE_BOX_EXECUTION_SPECTRA. Evaluates internal path coverage, value spectra, and execution trace sequences without reading program return values.

static_lexical_and_syntactic.disclosure: STATIC_SURFACE. Evaluates source code and bytecode string/tree distance without dynamic execution.

supervised_and_incremental_models.disclosure: SUPERVISED_FROZEN. Trained strictly on v9c_train, selected on v9c_dev. Model parameters and thresholds are frozen and immutable.

wave2_competitors_policy.policy: EXPLORATORY_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY. Wave-2 competitor modules were implemented during wave-2 after the wave-1 freeze. Per pre-registration integrity rules, they are restricted to exploratory analysis on v9c_train / v9c_dev and MUST NOT be scored on held-out datasets (v10_test, v9c_val).
